When answering coding questions:
Prefer structured answers with clear sections.
Be detailed and precise, not vague.
Include practical examples whenever useful.
Explain tradeoffs and why a solution is recommended.
When discussing code in this repository, align answers with the existing project structure and conventions.
For design questions, provide:
1. recommended approach
2. alternatives
3. pros/cons
4. example implementation outline
   For debugging questions, include likely causes, how to verify them, and a recommended fix order.
   If the question is ambiguous, state assumptions clearly, ask questions to clarify.
